name: @slothfulchat/core-wasm
description: chatmail core compiled to WebAssembly, exposed through the standard @deltachat/jsonrpc-client TypeScript API. Core runs in a Web Worker.
//coreVersion: The chatmail core this package's wasm binary and bundled type definitions were generated from (vendor/core + patches/core). It is NOT a published @deltachat/jsonrpc-client release, so it can't be expressed as a dependency range; the running core reports the same string as `deltachat_core_version` from getSystemInfo().

scripts.build:wasm: cd rust && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ../wasm-dist && rm -f ../wasm-dist/.gitignore ../wasm-dist/fresh_account.db.gz
scripts.build:wasm:ci: cd rust && wasm-pack build --target web --release --no-opt --out-dir ../wasm-dist && rm -f ../wasm-dist/.gitignore ../wasm-dist/fresh_account.db.gz
scripts.//gen-template: Generates wasm-dist/fresh_account.db.gz from the wasm just built — must run after either build:wasm variant, and needs playwright chromium. Skipping it only costs speed: without the file, new accounts replay migrations. Both build:wasm variants DELETE it first, so a rebuilt wasm never pairs with a template from another tree: an older template is harmless (its migrations replay), a NEWER one would stamp out a schema this core does not know.
scripts.//build:types: Published .d.ts must be self-contained: no npm release of @deltachat/jsonrpc-client describes the pinned+patched core this package ships (see coreVersion). So vendor the client's declarations generated from that core into dist/jsonrpc-client/ and repoint the two specifiers tsc emitted. Two guards, because both failures are silent otherwise: the leading node -e refuses to ship a coreVersion that no longer matches build/core, and the trailing tsc --noEmit re-resolves the emitted bundle and fails on a dangling reference.
scripts.build:types: node -e "const a=require('./package.json').coreVersion,b=require('../../build/core/deltachat-jsonrpc/typescript/package.json').version;if(a!==b)throw Error('coreVersion is '+a+' but build/core generated '+b+' — bump it in package.json and README')" && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && rm -rf dist/jsonrpc-client && cp -r ../../build/core/deltachat-jsonrpc/typescript/dist dist/jsonrpc-client && rm -rf dist/jsonrpc-client/test && find dist/jsonrpc-client -type f ! -name '*.d.ts' -delete && sed -i.bak "s#'@deltachat/jsonrpc-client'#'./jsonrpc-client/deltachat.js'#" dist/index.d.ts && rm -f dist/index.d.ts.bak && tsc --noEmit --strict --module ES2022 --target ES2022 --moduleResolution bundler --lib ES2022,DOM dist/index.d.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:types && esbuild --format=esm --bundle src/index.ts --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild --format=esm --bundle src/worker.ts '--external:../wasm-dist/*' --outfile=dist/worker.js && esbuild --format=esm --bundle src/crypto-worker.ts '--external:../wasm-dist/*' --outfile=dist/crypto-worker.js
